Every 5 minutes, check the living room temperature; if it is 28 degrees or higher set the air conditioner to cool, otherwise auto. Stop after 6 times.
Every 10 minutes, check the bedroom temperature; if it is below 20 degrees set the air conditioner to heat, otherwise auto. Stop after 4 times.
Every 1 minute, check the server room temperature; if it is 30 degrees or higher set the air conditioner to cool, otherwise auto. Stop after 10 times.
Every 30 minutes, check the office temperature; if it is 26 degrees or higher set the air conditioner to cool, otherwise auto. Stop after 5 times.
Every 15 minutes, check the living room temperature; if it is below 18 degrees set the air conditioner to heat, otherwise auto. Stop after 3 times.
